name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task's restriction is 'Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once', but the candidate renders it as RespondedExistence(key_lost, door_open), which only requires door_open to happen eventually after key_lost and permits dropping the key any number of times. Per the clause language, when the banned event's description already contains the condition (key_lost is defined as no longer carrying the key before the door is open), the ban is plain Absence(key_lost). Replace the RespondedExistence with a hard Absence(key_lost); keep the hard Existence(at_goal).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task bans losing the key while the door is closed and commands reaching the goal. Since key_lost is defined as a drop before the door opened, Absence(key_lost) captures the ban exactly, and the hard Existence(at_goal) covers the command.

texts: The agent never loses the key before opening the door
